recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-11477 unless a future broader editorial policy explicitly targets historical or localized spellings outside the current medications module source.
issue_request: FHIR-11477 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction from the Pharmacy work group for DSTU2. It asked to change the Medications Module wording from "Immunisations" to "Immunizations" and was auto-approved as a non-substantive typo fix.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-11477 was found. Git history shows b11f1f4131d2c977cef30cb82e26399fad2ecedc changed the exact source/medications-module.html heading from "Immunisations" to "Immunizations" on 2016-10-03, shortly after the Jira issue was created and voted.
additional_context: The current medications module source is in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. Later medications module work, including FHIR-53486, reorganized the same page while preserving the requested American spelling. Searches found no active source/ occurrence of "Immunisations" or "Immunisation", and no Zulip or Confluence evidence conflicted with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source already says "Recording of Immunizations" and uses Immunization/Immunizations throughout the relevant medications module text; remaining British-spelling hits are outside current source, such as translations or historical generated data.
